It shows Sculpt.3md nested at apps/sculpt with package name Rook, building against this checkout. Install docs say npm @corvidlabs/threemd 2.1.0 and crates.io threemd 2.1.0 are published. Contributor docs still require format changes in Swift, TypeScript, and Rust, and they do not call the app a fourth parser. fledge atlas at the repo root reports 100% implementation coverage. specsync check at the repo root stays 55/55. specsync check in apps/sculpt reports 94/94. Historical release receipts are not rewritten into a claim that Sculpt compact .3mdb is the upstream standard.
